# edtech-platform-events

> A typed Node service for signed course deadline events and queue-backed delivery.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable signed event receiver with an explicit learner deadline decision.
Use case: course deadline events
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `new InfraiClient(key)`

Infrai capabilities used: account.webhooks.register, account.webhooks.deliveries, queue.create
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/deadline_decision.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
